title: SEO inventory
intro: Stored content diagnostics for published public content. Counts describe the inspected records, not Google ranking or a rendered-page crawl.
scope: Theme-generated headings, builder sections, robots.txt rules, redirects, response status and private-page protection are not evaluated here. Empty alt attributes may be intentional for decorative images.
performance: Search impressions, clicks, position and actual indexing: not connected or verified.
noindex_note: noindex may be intentional; it is not counted as an error.
description_fallback: No saved description or excerpt; theme/body/site fallback may be used
duplicate_description: Repeated description or excerpt in this language
missing_alt: Body contains images without an alt attribute
empty: No published public content available to inspect.
limited: Scan capped at 5,000 records. Duplicates refer to this inspected set only.
